old_partition_reclassified: The former test positives are now explicitly development data; no blind-test claim is permitted.
audio_only_contract: ImprovedLocalizer.analyze(audio) accepts only a finite (1600,8) array sampled at 8000 Hz. Truth/scene/SNR metadata are used only by the evaluation driver after estimation.
baseline: Exactly reconstructed existing SRP-PHAT, checked against all 1000 saved baseline coordinates.
selection_rule: Select one globally applied candidate with lower overall mean spherical error AND greater overall within10 rate than PHAT; prefer lowest mean error among qualifying candidates. Report every tested candidate and all scene, SNR and scene-by-SNR effects, including degradation.
limitations: Development selection creates optimism. Any improved development score is provisional until the main thread validates frozen code on genuinely held-out independent trials. Localization scores are not calibrated UAV detection probabilities.
